elements.text:
During today's class, you have to present in front of your classmates and professor. You've been struggling to put this presentation together, but you haven't reached out to your professor about it yet. 

Here are some feelings that might happen in the moment:

texts: I feel happy that the presentation will be over with soon.
I am nervous that my professor will be let down by my progress.
I feel embarrassed about asking my professor for help, but I admire my confidence for putting myself out there.
I feel better knowing that classmates are going through the same thing I am.
I feel bad that I may not do as well on this presentation, but it's only one small part of my entire academic career.
